basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent convert to the world of numismatics, particularly fascinated by U.S. mint releases. Originally from the Midwest, I work as a junior data analyst by day and spend my evenings diving into various hobbies, including coin collecting and watching gaming streams. I'm single and often browse Reddit after work, usually between 6 PM and 11 PM. On weekends, I enjoy experimenting with bagel recipes, inspired by my love for all things bread.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm still very much a beginner in coin collecting, having started just a few months ago. Most of my knowledge comes from watching YouTube videos, reading articles, and participating in online forums. My approach is very much trial and error, with a focus on learning from more experienced collectors.
